violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) CUT TOMATO AT 48F AND CUT LETTUCE AT 48F IN 3 DR PREP TOP #2 (OOS); 2) RAW CHICKEN AT 45F, RAW SAUSAGE AT 50F IN 3 DR PREP RIGHT #5( IN USE) ; 3) COOKED MARINARA SAUCE AT 43F, COOKED TOMATO SAUCE AT 43F IN WIC 1 (IN USE)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. 1) EHS ASSISTED EMPLOYEE IS MARKING DISCARD TIME OF 3:00PM FOR CUT LETTUCE AND CUT TOMATO. CFM STATED UNIT IS OOS AND A REPLACEMENT HAS BEEN ORDERED. EHS ADVISED TO USE ICE TO KEEP CUT LETTUCE, CUT TOMATO AT 41F OR BELOW OR TO USE TPHC 4 HOURS UNTIL REPLACEMENT UNIT IS RECEIVED. 2) EMPLOYEE ADDED ICE TO CONTAINERS TO FACILITATE COOLING AND MAINTAIN PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURE OF 41F. 3) TEMPERATURE OF FOOD IN UNIT DECREASED AS TIME PROGRESSED WITHOUT EMPLOYEES GOING IN AND OUT OF UNIT. EHS ADVISED TO KEEP UNIT DOOR CLOSED AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE DURING MORNING PREP AND WHEN PLACING LARGE AMOUNTS OF COOKED FOODS IN UNIT. EHS ADVISED TO LOWER THERMOSTAT.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLE OF YELLOW CHEMICAL UNDER PREP TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EMPLOYEE LABELLED SPRAY BOTTLE WITH DISINFECTANT NAME.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: Minimize Bare Hand/Arm Contact with Non-RTE Foods
violations.observation: Excessive bare hand contact with exposed food that is not in a ready-to-eat form. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE USE BARE HANDS TO ADD COOKED PASTA TO BOILING WATER FOR REHEAT.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall minimize bare hand and arm contact with exposed food that is NOT in a ready-to-eat food. Foods like sugar, salt, flour, starch, etc. shall be dispensed using food scoops or utensils that are designed with handles to minimize bare hand contact. EHS STOPPED EMPLOYEE AND DISCUSSED THAT FOODS SHOULD BE DISPENSED/PORTIONED WITH SPOONS OR TONGS - EVEN IF FOOD IS BEING REHEATED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BOXES OF MEAT, BUTTER, CHEESE, WINE ON FLOOR OF WALK IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EMPLOYEE MOVED FOODS TO SHELVES. CANTINA D'ITALIA (Inspection Date: 03/13/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED ICE SCOOP WITH HANDLE STORED LAYING ON ICE IN ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH EMPLOYEES PROPER STORAGE OF ICE SCIPP. EMPLOYEE WILL STORE ICE SCOOP IN CLEAN CONTAINER NEXT TO ICE MACHINE WITH HANDLE UP.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed 0PPM chlorine solution at dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS worked with CFM and employees to prime sanitizer line and reach 50-200ppm chlorine solution output from dish machine. CFM and employees to verify concentration of chlorine solution dispensed before using.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: ground beef cooked 2 days prior, tomato sauce cooked 2 days prior.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM and employee understand to date mark prepared foods that are kept more than 24 hours.

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed can of water-displacement spray underneath prep table stored next to single-service items.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CFM moved can to area away from food, equipment, utensils, single-service items.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: observed various spices on 3 dr prep right with no labels.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM and employees to label all spices with common name.
